_meta.purpose: Explicit mapping for the dest index of transform 'qa-example-project-game-user-cohort'. Pinning active_dates as keyword (not date) is required so the Kibana data view runtime fields d1_live..d30_live can do String == String comparison. Without this, the transform falls back to dynamic mapping and infers active_dates as date from the ISO-date strings it emits, which breaks every retention runtime field (always emits 0). The *_cst pair (active_dates_cst / active_days_count_cst) is the Asia/Shanghai twin of the same facts and carries the identical keyword constraint for the identical reason — it feeds the CST data view's runtime fields, which the cst Space's retention panels read. Both zones are precomputed here because a cohort day-boundary cannot be re-derived at query time once the date string is written: a Space's dateFormat:tz only re-renders timestamps, it cannot re-bucket a date string that was already written in the other zone.
